source.protocol: Same dataset, parser, seed, animal-group split, features, model families, and hyperparameters as v4. Reproducibility rerun only; no tuning or candidate selection from this run.

timestamp_parser_diagnostics.sampling_assumption: Within each whole-second timestamp bucket, CSV row order is treated as 10 Hz sensor order; sub-second timing cannot be verified.

test_metrics_exploratory_post_selection.interpretation: These metrics reproduce v4 on the same exposed split. The animal holdout and candidate families were already inspected before v5; results are exploratory and are not independent validation, acceptance evidence, or a basis for selecting a runtime policy. The CUDA MLP's higher test macro-F1 does not override its much lower validation score.

validation_fit_steps.recording: Not emitted by the script for the temporary validation-fit model; derived as 45 epochs × ceil(13,746 / 1,024).

final_refit_steps.recording: Directly recorded in evaluation.json for the final CUDA model fit on 14,231 windows over 45 epochs, batch size 1,024.

total_steps.recording: One direct plus one derived fit; total is therefore partly inferred.

limitations: The held-out animal was previously inspected; the same animal split and candidate families were used in v4, so v5 is reproducibility evidence only.
No independent farm or cohort is available in this source; no biological or population-level generalization claim is supported.
Standing and lying have very small test support, making class-specific estimates unstable.
Timestamp buckets contain whole-second values; sub-second ordering and exact sensor cadence cannot be independently verified.
This is an activity classifier from nose-ring accelerometry, not an autonomous behavioral policy, physiological model, or causal response model.
artifact_policy: The dataset is public CC0; full evaluation, detailed reports, logs, and checkpoint remain private in Kaggle. Repository stores aggregate metrics and hashes only.
